title: "Opened by N" on each library row
objective: Under each library document, show how many different people opened it, like "Opened by 2", in an element with data-testid="opened-by". The same person twice counts once; the document owner's own opens never count; a document nobody else opened reads "Not opened". Also return openedBy (the number) on each document in GET /api/documents.
acceptance: d1 (two different visitors, one of them twice, plus the owner) reads "Opened by 2"
A teammate's open counts: d2 reads "Opened by 1"
d4, opened only by its owner, and d5, never opened, read "Not opened"
plan_summary: A distinct-viewers query excluding doc.ownerId in store.mjs, used by the page and the API.
